name: Spinal Cord Concussion / Cervical Cord Neurapraxia
tags: spinal cord concussion / cervical cord neurapraxia
definition: Transient neurological dysfunction after cervical trauma, often with temporary bilateral sensory or motor symptoms.

investigations.principle: MRI and CT assess cord, canal and structural injury before return-to-play decisions.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Return to contact sport requires specialist clearance.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neurological phenotype is secondary to spinal cord assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Transient neurological dysfunction after cervical trauma, often with temporary bilateral sensory or motor symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
